description:
### ⚠️ Requires [Sync](https://modrinth.com/mod/sync) to be installed! ⚠️

Defines a server-side data-driven keybind, registered on the client when they join. Belongs at `data/<namespace>/keybinds/<id>.json`.
markdownDescription:
### ⚠️ Requires [Sync](https://modrinth.com/mod/sync) to be installed! ⚠️

Defines a server-side data-driven keybind, registered on the client when they join. Belongs at `data/<namespace>/keybinds/<id>.json`.

key.description: The default GLFW key translation key (e.g. `key.keyboard.h`).The default GLFW key translation key (e.g. `"key.keyboard.h"`). See [Key Names](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=data_types/data_driven_keybinds#key-names) below.
key.markdownDescription: The default GLFW key translation key (e.g. `key.keyboard.h`).The default GLFW key translation key (e.g. `"key.keyboard.h"`). See [Key Names](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=data_types/data_driven_keybinds#key-names) below.

category.description: The Controls screen category this keybind is grouped under (e.g. `key.categories.misc`).The Controls screen category this keybind is grouped under (e.g. `"key.categories.misc"`). Custom category strings are supported and will be registered automatically.
category.markdownDescription: The Controls screen category this keybind is grouped under (e.g. `key.categories.misc`).The Controls screen category this keybind is grouped under (e.g. `"key.categories.misc"`). Custom category strings are supported and will be registered automatically.

name.description: A human-readable label hint. This does *_not_* change what is displayed in the Controls screen — add a lang file entry for that (see [Display Names](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=data_types/data_driven_keybinds#display-names)).
